notes:
### New
- **Tidy → Moved files** finds songs whose audio file was moved or renamed
  and points OpenCrate, Rekordbox and Engine DJ at the new place, keeping
  cues, grids, ratings and playlists. Only matches OpenCrate is sure of
  (same size and length) are ticked; the rest you check or choose. Backed up
  first, and undoable.
- **New playlist from selection:** right-click one or more tracks →
  **Add to playlist ▸ → New playlist from track…** asks for a name and makes
  the playlist with those tracks in it.
- **Loops come back from Engine DJ too:** with Two-way sync, loops you
  changed in Engine DJ are copied into Rekordbox as hot loops on the same pad
  (Rekordbox's memory loops stay).
- **Moved copies of a song are recognised** when syncing: a song that sits at a
  different path in another library (for example on a stick) is linked to the
  same song when exactly one song fits, so it isn't treated as a new one.
- **A new app icon:** a vinyl record as the O and a pair of DJ headphones as
  the C. **Settings → Appearance → App icon** lets you pick a background from
  27 choices (dark, white, pastel, bright and gradients).
- **Tidy → Artwork has three parts** (Missing covers, Shrink covers, Undo)
  with one list and one main button each, instead of two long lists on one
  page. **Find covers** now lists the tracks without a cover and looks them
  up online in one step. The main buttons are highlighted and larger.

### Fixed
- **Tag lookup works like Artwork:** one **Find tags** button lists the
  tracks and looks them up online in one step.
- **One look for buttons everywhere.** Main buttons, secondary buttons and
  delete buttons now have the same size, shape and colour on every screen,
  and Artwork's parts use the same tab style as the rest of the app.
- **Every long task can be stopped from the status bar** (the ✕ at the bottom):
  looking up covers or tags, checking and applying covers, scans and previews
  in Tidy and Sync, and Convert. Stopping a read-only check just gives up
  waiting for it; changes to your files are only ever stopped between files.
- **Starting a task no longer moves the screen.** Progress is shown only in
  the status bar at the bottom (with its ✕), not in extra bars on the page.
  Tidy's tag writing lost its separate "Stop and undo" button: stop it with
  the ✕, and undo it from Backups if you want the files back.
- **Tabs keep working in the background.** Switching to another tab no longer
  stops what a tab was doing, and its progress is still there when you
  come back.
- **Settings → Analysis and Convert:** text that was squeezed into a narrow
  column now reads normally.
